notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard FOM module composition. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador APIs and standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, base and additional FOM modules, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies create-time module composition, join-time additional modules, declaration visibility, and stable handles across members without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador create/join FOM-module composition and declaration lookup declarations
